citation: Jay, T., Willis, B., Thomas, P., Taylor, R., Moore, N., Burnett, C., Merchant, G., & Stevens, A. (2017). Dialogic Teaching: Evaluation report and executive summary. London: Education Endowment Foundation.
report_number: EEF project: Dialogic Teaching (Sheffield Hallam University evaluation, July 2017)
design: Cluster RCT (assignment = School, by minimisation); 76 schools randomised (38 intervention / 38 control); analysis 31 intervention + 38 control schools; Year 5 pupils (age 9-10, grades 3-6 band); subjects English, maths, science via GL Assessment Progress Tests; efficacy trial, business-as-usual control; immediate post-test (May 2016) after 2 terms of intervention
problems: EEF reports the effect size as a cluster-randomised standardised mean difference (ANCOVA mean diff / sqrt(sigma_S^2 + sigma_error^2)); the report does not explicitly print the small-sample J correction or whether it is labelled Hedges' g vs Cohen's d, but EEF convention treats this as g. Impact SE not printed directly; derived from the reported 95% CI (SE = CI width / (2*1.96)). Reported ANCOVA effect sizes exceed raw posttest d because intervention pupils had lower KS1 baseline (covariate adjustment increases the adjusted difference). 7 of 38 intervention schools dropped out / failed to return post-tests (on-treatment analysis, 21% pupil attrition). ICC = 0.10 is the design-stage ICC from the power analysis (Table 3), not a per-outcome observed ICC. Ns recorded are pupils contributing to each GL subject test (a subset assigned to each subject); n in model also reported. FSM-only subgroup results (Table 8) and sensitivity models (prior-attainment only) noted but not extracted as primary.

effect_sizes.arm_label: Dialogic Teaching (single TPD arm) vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.test_name: GL Assessment Progress Test in English
effect_sizes.g_method: EEF-reported cluster-randomised ANCOVA standardised mean difference (adjusted mean diff / sqrt(sigma_S^2 + sigma_error^2), total variance), from multilevel model controlling for KS1 prior attainment, pupil FSM, school-level %FSM/%EAL/KS2. Taken directly as g. SE derived from reported 95% CI (-0.001, 0.299): SE = (0.299-(-0.001))/(2*1.96); g_var = SE^2.
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.26 Table 7 (full-sample primary analysis); also p.5 Table 1 (exec summary)
effect_sizes.notes: English -> Reading per spec. Full-sample main-effects model. n=600/677 are pupils assigned to the GL English test; n in model = 1,198 (569 int; 629 ctrl). p = 0.05 (CI lower bound -0.001). GL Assessment is an independently published standardized commercial test.

effect_sizes.arm_label: Dialogic Teaching (single TPD arm) vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.test_name: GL Assessment Progress Test in Maths
effect_sizes.g_method: EEF-reported cluster-randomised ANCOVA standardised mean difference (total variance), multilevel model controlling for KS1, pupil FSM, school %FSM/%EAL/KS2. Taken directly as g. SE derived from reported 95% CI (-0.039, 0.199): SE = (0.199-(-0.039))/(2*1.96); g_var = SE^2.
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.26 Table 7 (full-sample primary analysis); also p.5 Table 1 (exec summary)
effect_sizes.notes: Maths -> STEM per spec. n=618/704 pupils assigned to GL Maths; n in model = 1,239 (577 int; 662 ctrl). p = 0.19 (not statistically significant).
